content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). The monitoring is medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period, as documented in the clinical indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
